story.what_it_does: Kalyan Jewellers is a large jewellery retailer with 507 showrooms across India, the USA, the UK and the Middle East at 31 March 2026. Most new stores are franchised (FOCO), and it also runs the Candere brand. FY26 consolidated revenue was about ₹3,57,429 million, up 43%.
story.plans: Management plans about 150 new showrooms in FY27 across Kalyan, Candere and a regional brand, including 84 India franchise stores and 50-55 Candere stores. It also aims to repay its non-GML debt in FY27 and to keep recycled gold at 55-60% of revenue.
story.moat: The notes show scale and growth: same-store sales growth was 27-47% in recent quarters and ROCE was 28.8% for FY26. Franchise stores need less capital and debt, which helps expansion. The notes do not describe any other durable edge.

scenarios.story: Franchise openings continue and demand stays strong, so revenue and profit keep growing as they did in FY26 (PAT up from ₹7,142 million to ₹13,504 million). Non-GML debt is repaid, which cuts interest cost by about ₹30 crore.
signals_to_watch: India same-store sales growth staying well above management's mid-to-high single digit target
Non-GML debt repayment completed in FY27

scenarios.story: Growth slows toward management's own planning level as the high base from H2 FY26 is lapped, while about 84 India franchise stores open. Margins stay somewhat lower than last year because of old gold exchange and the mix shift to franchise.
signals_to_watch: Consolidated EBITDA margin compared with 6.0% in Q1 FY27
Franchise share of India revenue (57% in Q1 FY27) and the progress of the 84 openings

scenarios.story: Gold price swings make customers delay purchases, and the one-time gains that helped profit fade. Governance questions, a thin answer on debt and a high base from last year add pressure.
signals_to_watch: Gold price volatility causing customers to delay purchases
Management's refusal to comment on past corporate governance and related-party concerns
